message: 季節はずれの紅白

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, Nana-chan! Big trouble, big trouble!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, Sacchin. I'm sick of hearing your 'big trouble'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't say that-- How can you keep such a calm face at a huge pinch like this--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You probably just forgot your homework or something like that, right」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, there's that too, but--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's already after school, Sacchin! It's way too late!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm telling you, this is way bigger trouble than that--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, just hear her out」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh, Synn-kun is so nice-- He's totally wasted on you, Nana-chan--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-what are you talking about?! I-it's not like Synn is mine or a-anything, um, w-well...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, Sacchin. What happened」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're just gonna ignore me?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You know, at Tanimura-san's place-- That thing got found out by my dad~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That shouldn't be a problem, right? We're basically just helping them out anyway」

name: Sacchin
message: 「But, but-- He got mad at me, saying that doesn't count as paying proper respects--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Your old man is as stubborn as ever, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not following the conversation here, what's going on?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm-- The Sweets Club, you see, is helping out a certain Western confectionery shop with their training」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah! Helping out by eating tons and tons of cake!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wrong! Taste-testing! We're cooperating on making new creations to boost their sales!」

name: Synn
message: 「So in other words, Sacchin's dad is angry about you guys eating and drinking without paying」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm amazed you figured it out just from that explanation...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't phrase it so it sounds shady! We got proper permission from the manager too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. True, Nanaka's reviews are supposedly amazing, so it might be worth treating her to sweets」

name: Sacchin
message: 「B-u-u-t, my dad runs a cake shop too, y'know, and he always says even freebies hurt the wallet~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, true... Even if they're prototypes, they still cost money, and there's no guarantee this team-up will 100% turn a profit...」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, why not help out in other ways besides just improving the cake's taste?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Other ways~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Once you've made sweets you're proud of, all that's left is getting everyone to know about them」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright! Sacchin! Let's call Yumil over right now and hold a strategy meeting!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, before that, about our homework----」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Save that for later, later!」

name: Synn
message: 「Good luck, you two~」
Now then, I think I'll drop by the library.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello~」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, Synn-kun. Welcome」

name: Synn
message: 「Has Nanaka not arrived yet?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hm? She was just here earlier」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Is the Sweets Club meeting already over?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. She said she had club activities for that, so she asked to take today off」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, did she already come up with something? She moves fast」

name: Ria
message: 「Is Nanaka-chan up to something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Apparently she's going to fulfill her code of honor」

name: Ria
message: 「Code of honor?」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'm curious what she's doing... I hope things don't take a weird turn」

name: Ria
message: 「You're worried about her, aren't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Nanaka is the type to charge straight ahead once she gets an idea in her head.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. In that case, since work has settled down for today, why don't you go check on her?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Good point. All right.」

name: Synn
message: 「--Well, it's great that I came out here, except I forgot to ask where she's doing it...」

name: Paqy
message: 「She mentioned something about Tanimura's place earlier.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tanimura, Tanimura... Hm? If I remember right, that's--」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, over there!」
Tanimura Peace Patisserie. It's the cake shop Nanaka introduced me to during KiraFes.

name: Synn
message: 「Looks like there's quite a crowd gathered.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is it really that rare for this place to be crowded?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka told me that ever since the manager changed, not many customers have been coming in, though...」

name: Paqy
message: 「So that's where Soba comes in, huh. Sure enough, no point making a fuss over just one or two cakes.」

name: Synn
message: 「I doubt it stopped at just one or two...」

name: Paqy
message: 「H―Hey, Lord Synn. Over there, could that be―」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Aaaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Welcome! For Christmas next month, be sure to bring home a Christmas cake from Tanimura Peace Patisserie!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're taking reservations right now! We have free samples too, so please feel free to try some!」
Nanaka was calling out to passersby with her usual bright, cheerful expression.
What was different from usual was her outfit.
Dressed in a Santa Claus costume, she was charming everyone walking down the street.
The skirt was a bit too short, making it hard to know where to look, but it suited her pretty well.

name: Synn
message: 「It's not even December yet, isn't that jumping the gun a bit?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What are you talking about? The Shiokumi Shopping District is already a fierce battleground when it comes to selling cakes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, true. So Nanaka is helping them out, huh...」
On top of that, the entire Sweets Club was gathered there.
Nanaka was a natural at it, and her junior, Okamoto-san, was following her lead and shouting out at the top of her lungs. That's the athletics club spirit for you.

name: Synn
message: 「Leave it to Nanaka. She's drawing customers in one after another. Though, what about Sacchin...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「W-Welcometh! Ow, I bit my tongue--」

name: Paqy
message: 「A true mascot, alright」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, Sh-Synn!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're working hard, Nanaka. Is there anything I can help with?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, n-no, it's fine! This is strictly Sweets Club business, after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Well, while I'm here, I'll place a reservation too--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Don't go spending money you don't have!」

name: Synn
message: 「Impressive... you know me all too well...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-Besides, even without making a reservation, um, well... for Christmas...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「The manager said, since they feel bad making us go this far, they're gonna give each of us one of these Christmas cakes--」

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't your dad not agree to that, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「As long as we make a profit even after subtracting our share, there's no problem--」

name: Paqy
message: 「I think you oughta save lines like that until you can actually do a decent job serving customers」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, yeah, basically……」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hah! I already knew it, though! There's no way you'd wear an outfit that erotic just for charity!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't make it sound so sleazy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ambasa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, I see. You really are kind, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-ahaha...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「She's working this hard just so she can eat together with everyone in the Student Council」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah... This dense idiot...\s10」

name: Sacchin
message: 「How unrewarding. You should just come right out and say it already」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't say something so irresponsible!」

name: Synn
message: 「All right. If we've got cake, then in order to secure drinks for the day, I'll help out at the Amakawa Milk Shop--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't need it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. That looks super good on you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Oh, really... th-thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: （Jeez, there's a limit to catching someone off guard. My heart started pounding...）

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? Nana-chan, your face is turning bright red」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong? Getting a little tired after all? Should I take over after all?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gaaah!! You're getting in the way of my work!! Both of you, get lost!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehhh!? Even me!?」
